topic: Someone finds their childhood teddy bear at a yard sale
text: I wandered through the aisles of mismatched dishes and old records, the kind of silence that hums with forgotten stories. There, wrapped in a faded sheet, was a bear. Not just any bear, but the one who had kept the shadows at bay, who knew my childhood dreams and my secret fears. His fur was as worn as the pages of a well-loved book, and his eyes, though clouded, still held the same quiet understanding. I held him, feeling the weight of time settle between us, the corners of the world blurring just a bit. It’s strange how things we thought we left behind keep waiting for us, unchanged, in the most unexpected places.
